description.value: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is a national fried-chicken fast food chain located on Kingsway in Burnaby. This dine-in and takeout location seats 36 guests and sits along a busy urban corridor that connects several cycling routes across the city. For a touring cyclist, it offers a quick hot meal stop without a drive-through queue.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 45m; rack (10 spaces) at 67m; rack (6 spaces) at 84m. Total: 24 spaces.
